Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Design-corrected AR, correction status/rcond guards and ExactSum pooled determinism are on main; the October 3 landing is retained. The original -0.357 rho failure is historical and S2 rev3 reports corrected harness recovery. Current heavy bias criterion remains skipped in the bounded gates.

Fresh context: Yes: partial audit / delivered correction.

Next action: Reconcile the remaining general fmriAR/fmrireg gap table and consumer parity, using the actual AR provider path and correction statuses. Keep optional bias requalification, first-level inference and upstream ExactSum ownership separate.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-cmp-s2-20261001.md; modules/ar; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Owner directive (2026-10-01): scalafim needs a correct general AR module that matches fmrireg/fmriAR; PHRF may have special needs on top of that.
Trigger: PHRF pilot S2 pre-fit rho-bias check failed. Trial cells gave rho_hat -0.357 against a true 0.3, and condition cells 0.341, because of the residual-projection bias. fmriAR has an exact correction (R/acvf_bias.R, b687924): E[gamma_raw] = A gamma_true, with A built from the residual-forming projection plus per-run centering and run/censor segmentation, then solving A gamma = gamma_raw. fmrireg's shared-AR path passes the design so the correction is applied (.estimate_shared_ar_parameters / .shared_ar_correction_design).
Scope: audit modules/ar (and its consumers in fit) against fmriAR and fmrireg AR handling. Deliver a gap table, parity fixtures, then implementation slices.
